reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about dislocation behavior, lattice distortions, and their link to mechanical properties in refractory BCC HEAs, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these key premises.
premises: Significant lattice distortions exist in refractory BCC HEAs
Lattice distortions promote edge dislocation-mediated plasticity over screw dislocation flow
Edge dislocations are more sluggish and distorted than screw dislocations in this environment
Predominance of sluggish edge dislocations is the primary cause of elevated hardness and strength
Reducing lattice distortion restores screw-dislocation-dominated flow and lowers strength
